ACL 2.1.0 and its bundled RTM headers come from the Unreal Engine 5.8 checkout
at 396c9f059 under Engine/Plugins/Animation/ACLPlugin/Source/ThirdParty/acl.
The MIT license for each library accompanies the corresponding headers.
Three redundant C++ template disambiguators in the ACL decompression header
were removed for current Clang. The runtime bridge belongs to bevy_als.
